retrievalProfile.description: A nostalgic 1990s-style group portrait featuring a triangular composition of subjects on a beach during a muted sunset with gradient-filled display typography.
excludeWhen: modern minimalist urban settings are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered group of three women in early 90s fashion (oversized coats, denim, floral dresses) posed on a rocky outcrop at a beach. The background features a soft, hazy sunset over a calm ocean. Large, stylized text with a vertical color gradient sits at the top of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Triangular arrangement of subjects with one standing and two seated
Text overlaying the sky area with a color gradient mirroring the horizon
Muted, warm color palette connecting the subjects to the natural environment
Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subjects against the vast sky
coreInvariants: Vertical color gradient within the primary display characters
Soft-focus horizon line separating sea and sky
Earth-toned fashion palette including tan, denim blue, and cream

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centralized triangular cluster; the standing figure acts as the apex, occupying the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The standing central figure in a dark hat and long brown coat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large gradient initials, moves down to the standing figure, then follows the seated figures' outward-facing poses to the edges of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive sky and beach areas provide a calm, airy frame for the central subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted earth tones (tan, sand, beige) in the foreground and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool blues and teals found in the denim and the top of the text gradient.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft peach and lavender hues in the sunset sky.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a mid-tone value range, creating a soft, nostalgic film-like quality.

letterConstructionRules: Initial capitals are significantly oversized and feature a vertical teal-to-purple gradient
Lowercase letters are thin, high-waisted, and condensed
Tight letter spacing for the smaller text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Oversized 'W' and 'P' with heavy vertical strokes and gradient fills
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between heavy, gradient-filled initials and delicate, monochromatic body characters.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and elegant verticality of the smaller text.
Provides the heavy skeleton needed for the large initial letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle photograph of three women in 1990s fashion posed in a triangle on a beach rock at sunset. Soft lighting, muted colors, hazy horizon.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered text at the top. Use large initial capitals with a teal-to-purple vertical gradient. Use thin, condensed cream-colored serif text for the remaining letters.

verificationChecks: Does the text feature a vertical gradient?
Is the color palette muted and nostalgic?

adjustableVariables: Specific fashion items (e.g., swapping a hat for a headband)
The specific colors used in the text gradient
mustRedesign: Avoid modern high-definition digital sharpness; maintain a soft film grain.
Ensure the text does not have a drop shadow.
postGenerationChecks: Check that the horizon line is level.
Verify the gradient in the text flows from top to bottom.
Ensure the subjects' clothing fits a cohesive 1990s earth-tone palette.
Confirm the text is centered and occupies the upper third of the frame.
recipe.reuseFormula: Triangular group pose + coastal sunset background + high-contrast condensed typography with vertical gradients.
